selection_rule: Resolve SCREEN_STATE only after carrier, composition, subject assembly, and object family. Only an object family that explicitly declares supported_screen_states may activate a generated screen. SIGNAL is the default active state; CARRIER is a conditional editorial-poster state that relocates one already locked support element into the screen.

screen_states.definition: The selected subject has no generated screen behavior.
screen_states.rendering_rule: Do not add a display, interface, glow, or control surface merely to make the subject look technological.

screen_states.definition: A powered-off or visually dormant period screen that preserves glass curvature and object identity.
screen_states.rendering_rule: Use deep active-hue glass, soft reflection, and material separation; avoid a broad neutral-black void.
screen_states.text_rule: No generated letters, numbers, labels, code, or pseudo-text.
screen_states.attention_rule: The screen remains materially legible but quieter than the object silhouette and title.

screen_states.definition: A restrained powered-on screen that gives an archive device a clear sign of operation without adding poster copy.
screen_states.rendering_rule: Use one sparse low-resolution signal family, such as a waveform with one block cursor, a vector trace, or a simple geometric scope. Derive phosphor light from ACTIVE_HUES and keep emission local to the screen.
screen_states.text_rule: No readable letters, words, numbers, code, menus, icons, dashboards, or pseudo-text.
screen_states.attention_rule: The signal reads only after the title and never becomes a second hero or a second focal event.

screen_states.definition: The screen becomes a structural carrier for one already approved editorial-poster support element.
screen_states.rendering_rule: Render exactly one short locked support string in compact low-resolution monospace with faint scanlines and restrained active-hue phosphor bloom; use one or two lines only and no surrounding UI.
screen_states.text_rule: The exact string remains designed copy, counts toward the 5–7 element poster budget, appears once inside the screen, and is removed from every external location. It is never INTRINSIC_ARTIFACT_TEXT.
screen_states.attention_rule: The screen is a support tier. At 25% thumbnail size the title remains first; the screen copy may become detail but the active screen may not compete with the title.

global_rules: Do not activate a generated screen on ABSTRACT_FORM or on an object family without explicit screen-state support.
Generated screen content is never INTRINSIC_ARTIFACT_TEXT. Authentic source-borne screen UI remains intrinsic and must not be replaced by a generated state.
For REPEATED_FAMILY, only the largest or compositionally primary instance may use SIGNAL or CARRIER; all subordinate screens remain DORMANT.
Use exactly one screen content system. Never combine signal graphics, readable copy, menus, charts, and decorative code.
Screen emission derives from ACTIVE_HUES and their tints. Do not introduce unrelated neon green, cyan, or amber by habit.
A generated screen may support the selected focal event but cannot become an additional focal event.
